rci2_using_epd.detail: HCP (Young Adult and Aging), UK Biobank, and IXI are all established public datasets used for normative model training
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "Data for training the web-based normative models used in Neurofind consisted of four publicly available datasets of healthy controls, namely the Human Connectome Project, the Human Connectome Project Aging, Biobank and IXI"

rci3_epd_name.detail: HCP encompasses both HCP Young Adult and HCP Aging datasets; UK Biobank referred to as 'Biobank' in paper; IXI from http://brain-development.org/ixi-dataset/
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "Data for training the web-based normative models used in Neurofind consisted of four publicly available datasets of healthy controls, namely the Human Connectome Project [61, 62], the Human Connectome Project Aging [63], Biobank [64] and IXI (http://brain-development.org/ixi-dataset/)"

rci5_n.detail: Training phase; same train set of 3362 HC used for both the Outlier Detection and Brain Age models; initial sample of 13,918 reduced after quality control, exclusion of age <20 or >80, and iterative outlier removal
rci5_n.supporting_text: "The final data for the train set comprised 3362 participants"
